paragraphs: Chapter 698
Episode 178. Deepening Concerns (2)
"Did I ask a difficult question? Your reaction is quite strong."
"Jin, how do you know that name?"
While Vishukel handed a handkerchief to Orgal, Zephyrin narrowed his eyes and spoke.
"I just know it."
"That's not a name you can simply know."
"Let's not delve too much into each other."

"You've always questioned how we learned any information we revealed. Have some conscience, please? This time, too, you took Princess Bianca and Prince Ranke under the pretext of protection conditions and made them do excessive things."

"Do you think what Bianca and Ranke did was too much for the conditions? The operation area to rescue Sister Yona was Akin. Actually, Zif who came after the operation ended created quite a tension for a while. He looked like he was considering attacking us. If Bianca and Ranke hadn't been there, he might have done it."

"It's strange to say that the chaos was suppressed because of those two. Have you forgotten? Zif is also our temporary ally. He must have been very upset about the betrayal of the tower keeper, but he's not stupid enough to break the alliance in front of the showdown with the evil deity."
"Didn't you hear it from Ranke and Bianca? Zif threatened us by saying that the alliance is no longer necessary. The situation has changed."

"I've said it once before, looking back, we Kinjelo have always been kind to you. I also had many moments when I had to help you. Of course, there were many times when we were trying to kill each other, but if this continues, we're the same as Zif."
"Really?"
Jin's eyes grew fierce.

"This is so annoying... Everyone takes the temporary alliance lightly, it's ridiculous. If you want to break the alliance, tell me right now, I'll listen. But if you threatened me under the pretense of warning, it's better not to do it again. Because then, I will be the one to break the alliance first."
As Jin said so and gathered his energy, a heavy vibration spread all around.
Veil seemed to be considering whether to release his power together, but he recalled Sandra's order that he should only move when Jin commanded.
In fact, Jin has no intention of breaking the alliance.
If Zephyrin responds now, 'Okay, the temporary alliance ends today.', Jin will be sulking.
Why are you doing this when it was just a joke.
However, Zif, who lost Hedo, may not know, but Jin thought it necessary to properly address this when even Kinjelo started to act like this.
In other words, Jin is bluffing so that Kinjelo can never give him an absurd warning under the pretext of an alliance again.
The tension with Zif alone is enough to give him a headache.
In response to the threat that had started, the Kinjelo side was silent for a moment. If it was anyone else, maybe, but Jin had never made an empty threat in such situations.
"Ha, what? This dog...."
However, unable to contain his anger, Zephyrin was about to pour out curses in a flurry, when Orgal opened his mouth.

[Cough, Zephyrin, don't get excited. It's obvious how Jin learned the name of Zito... He heard it from the Holy King. The Holy King must have received a revelation from Ayulra. Judging from the fact that you suddenly brought up Zito, it seems that there is a problem with his body that the Holy Kingdom is keeping.]
Orgal locked eyes with Jin.
Jin was always amazed when Orgal spoke of the world's secrets as if it was nothing.
[For now, stop your energy here, Jin Runkandel. I have no intention of breaking the alliance, so stop that bluff in the future. Is it that difficult to get along well?]
Actually, except for the mention of breaking the alliance rashly, Zephyrin was not wrong. Kinjelo always gave off the atmosphere that they wanted to get along well with Jin.
Yet, the reason why Jin always treated Kinjelo harshly was nothing else.
To Jin, they were still terrorists who indiscriminately killed ordinary people and conducted experiments, and after finishing with Rosa, they were enemies who must be annihilated.
So, Jin couldn't see Kinjelo in a good light. They were definitely not subjects he should treat conscientiously. He never received help without any compensation from the beginning.
"It's not a simple issue. Anyway, you know everything, Orgal."
[I've lived long. To answer your question, cough. Zito is a figure who is a punishment itself to our demon race. However, he is like a teacher to me.]
"So, is that why you tried to swallow the Holy Kingdom when I was a reserve knight? To regain the body of the teacher. The biological experiments were conducted on the side."
[You can think as you like. But that's a separate issue from dealing with the evil deity.]
"No, it's related. Because of that, the Holy Kingdom is unstable and the healing of the main force is being delayed."
[One thing I can certainly tell you is that I can't control the problems that arose in Zito's body.]
"Even if you could control it, I don't think you would."
[Even though it may be hard to believe whatever I say, it's a quite burdensome for me that he is waking up now.]
"It sounds like it would be good for him to wake up after you are completely healed."
[Why do you think Ayulra and the past saints of the Holy Kingdom have kept the fact that they have Zito's body from their descendants since the Holy Kingdom got it?]
Orgal laughed a little.
"Because they're worried someone will covet that power."
Watching Jin who answered immediately, Orgal nodded.
[You're almost right. Zito's energy has a power that tempts people. So, if I were to give advice, it would be good for you to always doubt your friend from now on.]
"What do you mean?"
[I hope that the current Holy King Rani Salome's faith is absolute enough to overcome that temptation. If she falls and resurrects Zito, it will be painful for everyone.]
At the moment when Jin was about to answer, Orgal laughed again.
[Just kidding. If Zito's body had such an effect, the Holy Kingdom would have collapsed long ago. Well, I've had my fun with Jin. Zephyrin, I hope your mood has lightened a bit too. Cough!]
Zephyrin smiled as if he was quite satisfied with Jin's twisted expression.
"It's been a while since the master has done something I'm grateful for. It's not easy to see that expression of Jin, I think I will be in a good mood for a week."
[I'm glad.]
Despite saying it was a joke, Jin couldn't help but feel uncomfortable.
Because he couldn't be sure that the reason why Ayulra and the old saints of the Holy Kingdom hid Zito's body from their descendants had nothing to do with Orgal's joke.
"It's been a while since I've given and taken in words. I'll remember that joke."
Knowing that Kinjelo is very concerned about Zito wasn't so bad.
[Anyway, Zito won't wake up before the decisive battle with the evil deity. Although I can't control it, I can at least predict that much......]
At the moment Orgal finished speaking, Marjiella cheerfully rolled her wheelchair from outside and entered.
"I'm late because I was napping. Nice to meet you, Sir Jin! You brought Sir Veil, right?!"
Marjiella bowed slightly to Veil who had been standing next to Jin like a screen.
She seemed genuinely pleased, her eyes shining brightly.
"Nice to meet you, Sir Veil. I'm Marjiella Evelyano."
"...What are you, do you know me?"
"I know you well! You are a trace of life from the sun, the most noble existence itself. We've been looking for you for a long time."
"You've been looking for me?"
Sun, Jin chewed on that word Marjiella had said.
'Come to think of it, Quicantel said, Veil introduced himself as a creature of the sun in the past......'
Suddenly, Jin looked at the large Kinjelo flag hanging behind Orgal's wall.
"The banner depicted Kinzelo's symbol, the intricate figure of the 'Broken Sun.'
Unable to take his eyes off the flag for a few seconds, Jin felt a chill run down his spine, a shiver of goosebumps.
'Is the existence that Kinzelo's lot claims to be the parent of life, intending to resurrect for the ultimate purification... referred to as the Sun God?'
There are numerous gods in the world. From those treated as minor deities like trinkets to someone, to gods governing enormous nature.
Most of these diverse gods have made their names known to the world through contracts with humans.
However, not only Jin, but most people in the world have not often heard the term 'Sun God.'
It was a term that one wouldn't hear unless some pseudo-magician claimed to be a Sun God and caused social unrest.
This is because there was no active god named 'Sun'.
In retrospect, it was strange.
The sun is the object most instinctively worshiped by humans, but there had been no god symbolizing it until now.
Orgal watched Jin silently, smiling.
'What you're thinking is probably right, Jin Runkandel.'
Jin was surprised, while Veil seemed unmoved by the fact that Kinzelo mentioned the Sun God.
The reason was that Veil had never met the one who formed him.
When he first appeared in the world, Veil knew only that he was born from the sun.
He never met him directly or received any special message from him.
Therefore, like Hedo a thousand years ago, Veil was unintentionally involved in various incidents, and in the process met Sara and became the Knight of the Ten Generations of Runkandel.
"Orgal, the reason I brought Veil was purely because it was helpful for your recovery. If I see any movement to take more than that for your purpose, I will immediately leave with Veil."
'Don't worry about that part.'
"Of course, your recovery alone would be a great gain for you guys. On one side is the Sun God, on the other is Heluram, on the other is the devil stone. Everyone is so colorful trying to complete."
'You are also working hard to communicate with Solderet again.'

"That's right, but I'd rather not be treated the same. Even if I can communicate with Solderet again, I don't think my goal is complete. Besides, I've always been curious about the meaning of the name Kinzelo... Was it the name of the god you were trying to resurrect?"
'Yes, that's the name of the being who created everyone here.'"
